primitives.name: Blockchain Injury Data Lifecycle
primitives.verbatim_quote: With the continuous development of blockchain and machine learning technologies, blockchain technology is used to collect, store, clean, mine and visualize the full-cycle data of football players' injuries, and machine learning is used to provide intelligent solutions for football players' injury recovery.
primitives.assumptions: Data integrity is preserved through cryptographic hashing; data access is permissioned.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When consensus mechanism fails or node integrity is compromised.

layer2.mapping: Each injury record is a node in a Merkle tree, enabling verifiable data lineage and tamper-proof audit trails.
